instructions.instruction: Guide guests forward from the restaurant entrance to the target table. Stop, inspect and grasp the chair back, pull the chair out along the floor, then release and finish with the arm stowed and head neutral.
instructions.instruction_zh: 从餐厅入口前向引导客人到目标餐桌，停稳后查看椅背，抓住椅背将椅子贴地抽出，松手并恢复自然收臂和头部中立姿态后结束。
